source.text:
name: Upload verified LRPM asset (manual only)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  upload:
    if: github.repository == 'miyazaki1016/emergencyalert' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Download previously verified LRPM artifact
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: gh run download 43653446881 --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --name lrpm-japan-20260101-v1 --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/lrpm-archive"
      - name: Extract and verify immutable archive
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/lrpm-archive/lrpm-japan-20260101-v1.tar.gz"
          echo '5fb0823f190e9ed893ba5ee9ae47aa7b1e4a8ad9c26601e2cae8b14bc1de33d8  '"$RUNNER_TEMP/lrpm-archive/lrpm-japan-20260101-v1.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check
          tar -tzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/lrpm-archive/lrpm-japan-20260101-v1.tar.gz" >/dev/null
      - run: npm install --no-save --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund tsx@4.20.6
      - name: Upload once (no overwrite) and verify
        env:
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.RAIN_ACTIONS_SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RAIN_ACTIONS_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
        run: node --import tsx scripts/upload-national-lrpm.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/lrpm-archive/lrpm-japan-20260101-v1.tar.gz"
